sonnet.problem: The question brings in 'Elymas' as 'the sorcerer, called Elymas here' before any story card has told verse 8. The earlier cards only named the sorcerer Bar-Jesus, and no card says Elymas is the same man. Verse 8 is cited, but the name equivalence is never stated, so the baker has no setup and the name looks like a new person.
sonnet.rule: He says two names mean the same person only when a verse says so outright, and he gives that verse.
